name: companies
label: Company
description: The organizations the org sells to, partners with or hires from.

name: people
label: Person
description: The people the org knows: leads, contacts and customers.

name: candidates
label: Candidate
description: People applying to the org's openings. Never an audience.
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `idx_candidates_public_ref` ON `candidates` (`public_ref`) WHERE public_ref != ''

name: applications
label: Application
description: A programme intake, promoted into a company and a person once accepted.

name: segments
label: Segment
description: A saved filter over one collection, evaluated whenever it is read.

name: lists
label: List
description: A hand-picked set of people or companies, kept for a purpose.

name: list_members
label: List member
description: One person on one list, once.

name: activities
label: Activity
description: The timeline: one row per message, meeting, form or order, written once per source.
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `idx_activities_source_id` ON `activities` (`source_id`) WHERE source_id != ''

name: tasks
label: Task
description: Work to do, on records, assigned to someone.

name: views
label: View
description: Saved views of a collection: the org's, which every member sees, and a person's own, which only they see. Which view a person opens first is their IAM preference.

fields.name: visibility
fields.label: Visibility
fields.description: org: every member of the org sees the view. private: only the person who made it does. Empty is org.
